Issue 4514: a cbuffer declared inside a namespace is not reachable through a
qualified name. Compare the panes rather than reading any one of them:

  pane 1  dxc 1.6.2112 -- the "December 2021" build named in the report; the
          qualified reference in main() is rejected by name lookup
  pane 2  dxc trunk    -- same rejection today, unchanged
  pane 3  dxc trunk -DWORKAROUND -- enables the reporter's extra Texture2D
          declaration in the namespace; compiles clean, same qualified
          reference
  pane 4  clang (HLSL) -fsyntax-only -- the qualified reference
  pane 5  clang (HLSL) -fsyntax-only -DUNQUALIFIED -- same shader, name used
          without the namespace qualifier; the control for pane 4

The whole finding is that panes 2 and 3 differ, and that the only difference
between them is a declaration main() never mentions.

Compiler Explorer runs Linux Release builds; the local evidence is a Windows
Debug build. CE also appends its own debug-info flags to the DXC panes.
